assertions.title: Project creation and listing works

steps.action: Open /sign-up and create the assigned isolated account
steps.expected: Signup succeeds and redirects into an authenticated dashboard session
steps.observed: The UI stayed on /sign-up and rendered an inline grain activation failure: auth grain activate: node runtime dependency "janus-node-runtime" not found in injected dependencies.

steps.action: Open /get-started, switch to Projects, and inspect the empty state
steps.expected: An authenticated user sees the New Project form plus an empty starting list before creating the first project
steps.observed: The dashboard showed Signed out, Projects 0, and No projects yet.

steps.action: Populate the New Project form and submit it
steps.expected: A project is created, listed, and exposes Use Across Workflows propagation
steps.observed: Submitting the populated form surfaced an inline unauthorized message and the project list remained at 0 total.

evidence.network: Browser signup submit stayed on /sign-up with inline failure; corroborating API check: POST /api/v1/auth/signup -> 202 Accepted, then GET /api/v1/operations/op_5f02f1d3a4ff2ec25bebcc58 -> 200 {status: failed, failure.code: service_unavailable, failure.message includes missing janus-node-runtime dependency}. Signed-out projects probe: GET /api/v1/projects -> 401 unauthorized.

assertions.issues: Blocked by a broken authentication prerequisite: isolated signup fails, so project CRUD cannot be exercised in an authenticated session.

assertions.title: Repository import triggers a build

steps.action: Inspect the Repo Import panel in Pipeline view
steps.expected: An authenticated project can be selected before importing a repository
steps.observed: The Project selector only exposed Select project and Import Repository stayed disabled.

steps.action: Enter a valid public repository URL and branch
steps.expected: Submitting creates an import operation and a new build result
steps.observed: The repo URL and branch fields accepted values, but no project was selectable so the import could not be submitted.

steps.action: Confirm project data availability for the same signed-out surface
steps.expected: The dashboard can load projects to unlock the import workflow
steps.observed: The signed-out prerequisite remained broken and the projects endpoint returned 401 unauthorized.

evidence.network: GET /api/v1/projects -> 401 unauthorized. No POST /api/v1/repos/import request was reachable from the UI because the project selector never populated beyond its placeholder option.

assertions.issues: Blocked upstream by failed authentication and the resulting lack of any selectable project for repo import.

assertions.title: File uploads work for source bundles and WASM artifacts

steps.action: Inspect the Direct Uploads panel in Pipeline view
steps.expected: Both upload forms can select a project and proceed to file submission
steps.observed: Both Project selectors only exposed Select project, leaving Upload Source Bundle and Upload WASM Artifact disabled.

steps.action: Check whether the blocker occurs before file submission
steps.expected: The forms reach file-selection and multipart submission once project data loads
steps.observed: The blocker occurred earlier: no authenticated project list existed, so file-upload submission could not be reached.

steps.action: Confirm project data availability for uploads
steps.expected: Projects load for the signed-in dashboard session
steps.observed: The projects endpoint returned 401 unauthorized in the same signed-out state.

evidence.network: GET /api/v1/projects -> 401 unauthorized. No POST /api/v1/uploads/source-bundles or POST /api/v1/uploads/artifacts request fired because both upload forms were blocked at project selection.

assertions.issues: Blocked because uploads require an authenticated project context and signup never produced one.

assertions.title: Builds panel displays status, filtering, and log viewing

steps.action: Inspect the Build Status panel
steps.expected: Build cards, stats chips, filtering, and View Logs entry points are available once build data exists
steps.observed: The panel rendered Total: 0 and No builds yet.

steps.action: Check for log entry points in the rendered DOM
steps.expected: At least one build row exposes View Logs after data loads
steps.observed: A DOM probe returned viewLogsButtons: 0.

steps.action: Confirm build data availability for the signed-out session
steps.expected: The dashboard can retrieve builds for the authenticated user
steps.observed: The builds endpoint returned 401 unauthorized.

evidence.network: GET /api/v1/builds -> 401 unauthorized. DOM probe on /get-started returned {"viewLogsButtons":0,"endpointLinks":0}.

assertions.issues: Blocked by the missing authenticated build data needed to populate build cards, filtered counts, and log entry points.

assertions.title: Deployment creation and listing works

steps.action: Inspect the deployment creation form
steps.expected: An authenticated project and built artifact can be selected before deploying
steps.observed: The Project selector only exposed Select project, the Artifact Build selector only exposed Select artifact build, and Create Deployment stayed disabled.

steps.action: Inspect the deployments list state
steps.expected: Deployment rows can render and be filtered
steps.observed: The panel showed Total: 0 and No deployments yet.

steps.action: Confirm deployment data availability for the same session
steps.expected: The dashboard can retrieve deployments for the authenticated user
steps.observed: The deployments endpoint returned 401 unauthorized.

evidence.network: GET /api/v1/deployments -> 401 unauthorized. No POST /api/v1/deployments request was reachable from the UI because the form never had a valid project or build selection.

assertions.issues: Blocked by the missing authenticated project/build data needed to create and list deployments.

assertions.title: Domains panel displays bindings with endpoint links

steps.action: Inspect the Domains panel
steps.expected: Domain rows render with project, deployment, status, and endpoint link details
steps.observed: The panel rendered Total: 0 and No domains yet.

steps.action: Check for endpoint links in the rendered DOM
steps.expected: Rendered domain rows expose reachable endpoint links
steps.observed: A DOM probe returned endpointLinks: 0.

steps.action: Confirm domain data availability for the same session
steps.expected: The dashboard can retrieve domain bindings for the authenticated user
steps.observed: The domains endpoint returned 401 unauthorized.

evidence.network: GET /api/v1/domains -> 401 unauthorized. DOM probe on /get-started returned {"viewLogsButtons":0,"endpointLinks":0}.

assertions.issues: Blocked because no authenticated deployments or domain bindings could be listed.

assertions.title: Log modal displays, filters, and exports logs

steps.action: Look for View Logs entry points on build and deployment panels
steps.expected: At least one build or deployment row exposes View Logs and opens the modal
steps.observed: No build or deployment rows rendered, and a DOM probe returned viewLogsButtons: 0.

steps.action: Confirm whether build and deployment data exists for the session
steps.expected: Authenticated build or deployment data provides a modal-open path
steps.observed: Both builds and deployments endpoints returned 401 unauthorized.

steps.action: Attempt to reach a modal-open path through the assigned dashboard panels
steps.expected: The modal opens and exposes filter, auto-update, copy, download, and close controls
steps.observed: No modal-open path existed in the signed-out empty states, so the log modal could not be opened at all.

evidence.network: GET /api/v1/builds -> 401 unauthorized; GET /api/v1/deployments -> 401 unauthorized; DOM probe on /get-started returned {"viewLogsButtons":0,"endpointLinks":0}.

assertions.issues: Blocked because the signed-out dashboard exposed no build or deployment rows from which to open the log modal.

frictions.description: The signed-out dashboard renders normal-looking empty states while the underlying data endpoints fail with 401 responses, so the auth blocker is not obvious from the visible UI alone.
frictions.resolution: Corroborated the blocker with explicit endpoint probes for /projects, /builds, /deployments, and /domains.

blockers.description: Isolated account creation is still broken: signup operations fail because the auth grain cannot activate without the injected janus-node-runtime dependency.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Tried the browser sign-up flow with the assigned account and retried the signup via the assigned retry email; both produced the same missing janus-node-runtime dependency failure.

blockers.description: Because the browser session remained signed out, downstream dashboard data endpoints stayed unauthorized and every panel remained stuck in placeholder/empty states.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Probed /api/v1/projects, /api/v1/builds, /api/v1/deployments, and /api/v1/domains from the same signed-out condition; each returned 401 unauthorized.

summary: Re-ran all 7 assigned dashboard panel assertions. All 7 remain blocked: the assigned isolated signup still fails with the missing janus-node-runtime dependency, and the resulting signed-out dashboard receives 401 responses for projects, builds, deployments, and domains while rendering only empty states and disabled forms.
